b: The unveiling of the video marks 40 years since the release of Your Funeral... My Trial
Nick Cave & The Bad Seeds have shared previously unseen live footage from a performance they did at Manchester's International II in 1986.

The archival video was captured on VHS while Cave and band were touring their 1986 albums Your Funeral... My Trial and Kicking Against The Pricks, and have been newly shared to mark 40 years since the release of the two records. The live lineup at the time featured Cave, Mick Harvey, Blixa Bargeld, Thomas Wydler, Kid Congo Powers and Roland Wolf.
